partners_individual_names_check.name: partners_individual_names_check
partners_individual_names_check.value: "partners"."kind" <> 'individual' or ("partners"."first_name" is not null and "partners"."last_name" is not null)

credit_sales_receipts_void_check.name: credit_sales_receipts_void_check
credit_sales_receipts_void_check.value: "receipts"."state" <> 'voided' or ("receipts"."voided_at" is not null and "receipts"."void_reason" is not null)

leads_lost_check.name: leads_lost_check
leads_lost_check.value: "leads"."status" <> 'lost' or ("leads"."lost_reason_id" is not null and "leads"."lost_at" is not null)
